# TrailOps

> TrailOps is an AI systems, n8n automation, and SaaS development studio based in Sheridan, Wyoming, USA. We build and ship production-grade workflow automation, LLM integrations, conversational agents, and full-stack web applications with 100% client code ownership and fixed-price milestone delivery.

- Canonical URL: https://trailops.biz/
- LLMs File: https://trailops.biz/llms.txt
- Pricing Guide: https://trailops.biz/pricing.md
- Location: 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA
- Contact: support@trailops.biz

---

## Core Services & Documentation

- [Workflow Automation](https://trailops.biz/workflow-automation.html): End-to-end n8n, Zapier, and Make pipelines for mission-critical operations: lead routing, CRM sync, notifications, and API orchestration with zero per-task fees.
- [AI Integration & Agents](https://trailops.biz/ai-integration.html): Production LLM integrations (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini, Ollama), custom RAG vector search, structured outputs, and autonomous agent workflows.
- [AI Chatbots & Agents](https://trailops.biz/ai-chatbots-agents.html): Embedded conversational agents, customer support automation, lead qualification bots, and internal company knowledge agents.
- [SaaS MVP Development](https://trailops.biz/saas-development.html): Multi-tenant web applications built on Next.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Stripe — from initial MVP to scalable production software.
- [Automation Strategy & Audit](https://trailops.biz/automation-strategy-audit.html): Systems architecture review, operational bottleneck mapping, SaaS task cost reduction, and actionable implementation roadmaps.
- [SEO & Generative Engine Optimization](https://trailops.biz/seo-optimization.html): Technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, Core Web Vitals optimization, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO).
- [Social Media & Content Ops Automation](https://trailops.biz/social-media-automation.html): AI-driven multi-platform content scheduling and publishing pipelines via LinkedIn and Meta Graph APIs.
- [Pricing & Engagement Guide](https://trailops.biz/pricing.md): Complete machine-readable pricing breakdown, milestone models, and scope timelines.

## Featured Work & Projects

- [WYSIWYG HTML Editor](https://trailops.biz/wysiwyg.html): Free, browser-based HTML visual and code editor with live syntax inspection, templates, and export utilities (Live at https://wysiwyg-six.vercel.app).
- [Stylchat](https://trailops.biz/stylchat.html): Embeddable chat widget builder designed specifically for n8n webhook pipelines with live styling and file handling (Live at https://www.stylchat.com).
- [Novodesk](https://trailops.biz/novodesk.html): Fast, lightweight customer support ticketing platform with multi-workspace management, RBAC, and queues (Live at https://www.novodesk.cc).
- [Featured Work Portfolio](https://trailops.biz/featured-work.html): Comprehensive project breakdowns with architecture overviews and performance metrics.

---

## Key Differentiators & Principles

- **Zero Vendor Lock-in / 100% Code Ownership**: Clients receive full source code, deployment scripts, environment configs, and repository access upon completion.
- **No Per-Task Fees**: Specialized in self-hosted n8n and open-source infrastructure to eliminate high-volume Zapier and Make subscription fees.
- **Fixed-Price Scoping**: Transparent quotes with explicit milestones and deliverables; no surprise hourly billing.
- **Production-Grade Reliability**: Error handling, automated retry queues, rate-limit management, and 14–30 day post-launch warranty.

---

## Technical Specifications

- **Automation Engines**: n8n (Self-hosted / Cloud), Zapier, Make, custom Node.js / Python workers
- **AI & LLM Providers**: OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), Google Gemini (1.5 Pro / Flash), Ollama / Llama 3
- **Web & Database Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, pgvector
- **Payments & Deployment**: Stripe Billing & Connect, Vercel, Railway, Docker, AWS
